rationale_highlights: his childhood, youth, and upbringing point to instability and trauma that may have roots in an Indigenous issue

his moral blameworthiness is lessened because of his very difficult family circumstances growing up

the systemic background factors of Mr. Robertson which may bear upon his moral culpability
